# docs/templates/

> L2 | Parent: [../README.md](../README.md)

course-original.mdx: Noncompiled frontmatter-only course template; replace sample identity and every example field.

course-translation.mdx: Noncompiled frontmatter-only translation template; preserve original identity and source revision.

lesson-original.mdx: Noncompiled original-lesson template with a stable ID.

lesson-translation.mdx: Noncompiled translated-lesson template for reviewed target-language content.

Course overviews render metadata and the generated syllabus, not an MDX body. Lesson templates include the article body.

[PROTOCOL]: Update this header when making changes, then check README.md.
